question: Whether truncated-Gaussian / orthant-moment identities provide a genuinely distinct Phase-2-feasible estimator for expected activations in deep ReLU MLPs.

single_gaussian_exact_pair_moments.reason: Replacing E038's 16-node conditional-Gaussian pair-moment integration by exact Tallis/Rosenbaum/Plackett bivariate orthant moments changes the Gaussian pair-moment evaluator, not the carried state or layerwise re-Gaussianization closure.
single_gaussian_exact_pair_moments.cost_order: O(L*n^3 + L*n^2 pair-moment evaluations), O(n^2) state
single_gaussian_exact_pair_moments.accuracy_obstruction: E111 exact-small evidence shows Gaussian ReLU moment plug-in bias appears immediately after the first ReLU even when pre-ReLU first two moments are exact.

exact_gate_conditioned_truncated_gaussia.representation: Retain orthant/sign-mask probabilities and truncated-Gaussian conditional moments instead of collapsing to one Gaussian.
exact_gate_conditioned_truncated_gaussia.worst_case_state: Explicit all-mask output size: Theta(2^n*n) with one conditional first-moment vector per mask; Theta(2^n*n^2) with one full conditional covariance per mask.
exact_gate_conditioned_truncated_gaussia.blocker: No audited theorem supplies a reusable polynomial-size non-Gaussian all-mask state that composes through generic dense ReLU layers with rigorous propagated error and a credible <2^41 FLOP / <0.4 s residual bound. This is distinct from a single orthant query, for which randomized polynomial-time algorithms exist.
exact_gate_conditioned_truncated_gaussia.adjacent_prior: E039 fixed two-component half-space Gaussian mixture and E114-E119 exact activation-boundary state

boundary_integral_route.reason: Gaussian boundary/Price evaluation maps to E036/E038; exact deep activation-boundary geometry maps to E114-E119.
boundary_integral_route.compression_evidence: E119 exact small-width certificate retained about 98.18%-98.80% of boundary atoms and could not omit any nonzero atom on its frozen corpus.

falsifier.reason: No genuinely distinct cost-feasible estimator survived theory-first novelty/cost screening. R321 clarifies that the blocker is not single-orthant query complexity but the absence of a reusable polynomial-size propagated non-Gaussian all-mask state; explicit all-mask state has exponential output size.

r324_clarification.caveat: Do not claim that one correlated Gaussian orthant/convex-set query is inevitably exponential. Kannan-Li 1996 and Cousins-Vempala 2014 provide randomized polynomial-time algorithms for relevant single restricted-Gaussian queries.

explicit_all_mask_state.statement_type: explicit-state output-size bookkeeping, not a lower bound for one orthant integral

r324_clarification.actual_blocker: No reusable polynomial-size non-Gaussian all-mask state was found that composes through generic dense ReLU layers with rigorous propagated error and derivable Phase-2 FLOP/residual bounds.
r324_clarification.single_query_sampling_limitation: A probability/sampling query for one restricted Gaussian does not create the persistent state needed by the next dense layer and supplies no contest-level final-MSE, FlopScope, or residual-time guarantee.
r324_clarification.structured_tmvn_caveat: Fast hierarchical/low-rank TMVN algorithms exist under rank/sparsity/low-effective-dimension assumptions, but those assumptions are not established for generic dense contest covariance transport.
r324_clarification.history_policy: single append-only commit; no rebase/reset/history rewrite
